Tooltip_DVF_Coldpack:
Chill it in a fridge (half way) or a freezer (fully), or leave it out below freezing.
In a cooler it keeps food cold. Loose, it warms up within a couple of hours.
Used in improvised defensive devices. Requires known recipe, or Engineer profession.
Tooltip_DVF_Cooler:
Put chilled cold packs in with the food to keep it as cold as a fridge would.
Each frozen pack adds a few hours, and packs in the same cooler add up.
